# tpuf_namespaces (Data Source)

Lists turbopuffer namespace names, optionally filtered by prefix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tpuf_namespaces" "prod" {
  prefix = "prod-"
}

output "prod_namespaces" {
  value = data.tpuf_namespaces.prod.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `prefix` (String) Only return namespaces whose name matches this prefix.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Namespace names.
